assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has documented supraventricular tachycardia
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient reports brief neurological deficits
Ambulatory cardiac event monitoring is ordered
The cardiac event monitoring is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management
CPT code 93271 for ambulatory cardiac event monitoring
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the documented neurological deficits and supraventricular tachycardia associated with the transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The appeal addresses the denial under reason code CO-22
The service cannot be attributed to another payer's coverage
